description: Na₉Sm(SiSe₃)₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SmSe₆ octahedra, corners with three NaSe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SiSiSe₃ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one SmSe₆ octahedra, edges with nine NaSe₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SiSiSe₃ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-8°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.94-3.26 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SmSe₆ octahedra, corners with three NaSe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SiSiSe₃ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one SmSe₆ octahedra, edges with nine NaSe₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SiSiSe₃ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-9°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.96-3.17 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SmSe₆ octahedra, corners with three NaSe₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SiSiSe₃ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one SmSe₆ octahedra, edges with nine NaSe₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one SiSiSe₃ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-8°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.97-3.18 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SiSiSe₃ tetrahedra, and edges with nine NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-8°. There are four shorter (3.09 Å) and two longer (3.11 Å) Na-Se bond lengths. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SiSiSe₃ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one SmSe₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-9°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.08-3.15 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to six Se atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SiSiSe₃ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent SmSe₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-8°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.03-3.11 Å. Sm is bonded to six Se atoms to form SmSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaSe₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SiSiSe₃ tetrahedra, and edges with nine NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-8°. There are a spread of Sm-Se bond distances ranging from 2.95-2.98 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se atoms. There are a spread of Si-Se bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.36 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to one Si and three Se atoms to form distorted SiSiSe₃ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent SmSe₆ octahedra, corners with three SeNa₄SmSi octahedra, corners with seven NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with three NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-78°. The Si-Si bond length is 2.32 Å. There are a spread of Si-Se bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.33 Å. There are six inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Si atom to form SeNa₅Si octahedra that share corners with seven SeNa₄SmSi octahedra and edges with ten SeNa₅Si octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-89°. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to four Na, one Sm, and one Si atom to form distorted SeNa₄SmSi octahedra that share corners with seven SeNa₅Si octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SiSiSe₃ tetrahedra, and edges with ten SeNa₅Si octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-92°. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to four Na, one Sm, and one Si atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₄SmSi octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-91°. In the fourth Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Si atom to form SeNa₅Si octahedra that share corners with seven SeNa₅Si octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SiSiSe₃ tetrahedra, and edges with ten SeNa₅Si octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-92°. In the fifth Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Si atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₅Si octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-89°. In the sixth Se site, Se is bonded to four Na, one Sm, and one Si atom to form distorted SeNa₄SmSi octahedra that share corners with seven SeNa₅Si octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SiSiSe₃ tetrahedra, and edges with ten SeNa₅Si octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-93°.
